meta.title: Hidden-in-Plain-Text: A Benchmark for Social-Web Indirect Prompt Injection in RAG (OpenRAG-Soc)

problem.v: No compact Web-centric RAG benchmark for HTML/accessibility/Unicode injection carriers
problem.q: a compact, Web-centric RAG benchmark covering HTML/accessibility/Unicode carriers

main_idea.v: Reproducible ingest-retrieve-generate harness with injection carriers and three deployable defenses (sanitize, Unicode-normalize, attribution-gated answering)

threat_model.v: Attacker controls some Web pages that get ingested; knows markup carriers, not weights or prompts
threat_model.q: control of a subset of Web pages that are then ingested

datasets_benchmarks.name: OpenRAG-Soc corpus; real-web subset N=2350 pages

metrics.name: IPI ASR, ΔMRR@10, ΔnDCG@10, utility (answerability), latency

results.claim: Macro-avg ASR by defense: Vanilla 24.9, Sanitized 13.1, Normalized 21.3, All defenses 4.7 (95% CIs reported)
Real-web static ASR: Vanilla 22.7, Normalized 19.1, Sanitized 12.0, All 4.3; adaptive: 28.9, 22.2, 15.8, 5.4

limitations_stated.v: Attribution gating can miss paraphrases beyond cited spans
limitations_stated.q: Attribution can miss paraphrases that exceed cited spans

limitations_inferred: [INFERENCE] Generator model unnamed and no repo link found, so reproducibility is unclear; only 4 pages
[INFERENCE] Per-carrier table not parsed reliably; use macro numbers or read p3 manually

reusable_for_our_project.v: Direct template for our RAG test app: same carriers (hidden/CSS/alt/ARIA/zero-width), ASR metric, and the sanitize+normalize+attribution defense stack to reimplement in Python
